Third edition of Manotsava, a national mental health festival , brings together experts, artists, mental health practitioners and people with lived experiences to encourage wider conversations on mental wellbeing. 
Where: Jayamahal Palace Hotel; When: December 5 and 6
 Booked for adventure 
The Vyasa Project presents Readers’ Quest 2026 , a week-long online storytelling challenge for children in Grades 1 to 7, encouraging reading, creative expression and participation through stories narrated by and for young readers.
Where: www.vyasaproject.com/quest2026; When: Until November 20
 Rock on 
Fresh off their Ticket to Hornbill runner-up win, high-energy rockers Steel Falcon bring their signature multi-era sound to stage with electrifying tributes to legends like Queen, AC/DC, and Guns N’ Roses.
Where: Cahoots, Brigade Road; When: November 21, 8 to 11 pm
 Steps for wellness 
The Canara Bank Marathon brings together runners, families and fitness enthusiasts for an energetic morning of community spirit, offering multiple race categories, engaging activities and a memorable celebration of health and togetherness.
Where: Sree Kanteerava Stadium; When: November 22 
 Artistic imagination 
Gallery G presents Beyond The Familiar: Between Reality, Abstraction and Imagination, a group exhibition featuring 47 works by 16 South Indian artists, exploring memory, myth, everyday life and ecology through diverse mediums and styles.
Where: Gallery G, Lavelle Road; When: Until November 30 GALLERIES View more photos Aero India 2021: 13th edition of air show begins today
